request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of TxPipe as vendor
request.what: Fund 12 months of part-time maintenance and enhancement work for Oura by TxPipe, including codebase maintenance, community support, and AI-friendly documentation/integration resources.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 540,750 ADA total, consisting of 525,000 ADA for Oura maintenance and enhancement plus a 15,750 ADA Intersect Budget Administration fee.
The motivation states the core funding request is 420,000 ADA plus a 105,000 ADA contingency reserve for a part-time Oura maintainer over 12 months at an annual rate of $105,000 USD.
Oura is described as a Rust-native Cardano event pipeline tool that connects to Cardano nodes, monitors blockchain events, and routes matching patterns to pluggable outputs.

The proposal says Oura supports multiple data sources including N2C, N2N, S3, Mithril, and UTxO RPC, and sinks including Kafka, Elasticsearch, AWS services, RabbitMQ, Redis, SQL databases, and webhooks.
The document states Oura has 654 commits, 288 stars, 79 forks, and 58 contributors, and provides the GitHub repository as a checkable source.
The proposal claims Oura is used across the ecosystem for indexing, monitoring, analytics, and real-time event processing.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold in the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and links to voting and audited-result references.
The proposal states the withdrawal does not breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the time of submission.
The document states TxPipe received funding through 30 Project Catalyst proposals across Funds 9 through 14, with 26 delivered and 4 currently under development and on schedule.

The proposal says funds will be administered through Intersect using Sundae Labs treasury management smart contracts, external oversight entities, reporting obligations, and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document asks for 540,750 ADA to fund 12 months of Oura maintenance by TxPipe through Intersect-managed smart contracts, presenting Oura as established open-source Cardano infrastructure with governance-process support, NCL compliance, and oversight controls.
